name: GPU Mesh Voxelization via Plane/Projection Tests
aliases: GPU Voxelization via Plane and 2D Projection Tests
definition: A GPU-based method to convert a triangle mesh into a voxel grid by testing each voxel in the triangle's bounding box against the triangle's plane and its 2D projections on XY, YZ, and ZX planes.
summary: GPU Mesh Voxelization via Plane/Projection Tests converts triangle meshes to solid 3D voxel grids by testing voxels against plane equations and 2D projections, distinguishing itself by using explicit geometric containment rather than compact bitmasks.
